text: Kapag sinisingitan ng “-um-” ang salitang-ugat na “sulat”, ano ang mabubuong pandiwa?
gloss: The infix -um- inserted into the root "sulat" (write) gives which verb? — "sumulat": -um- goes after the first consonant.

text: Kung “maglalaro” ang gagawin pa lang, ano ang tamang anyo kapag tapos na ang paglalaro?
gloss: If "maglalaro" is the future (will play), what is the completed form? — "naglaro": mag- becomes nag- for a finished action, without the reduplication of the ongoing "naglalaro".

text: Ikalawa, ikatlo, ikaapat… Anong salita ang nauuna sa kanilang lahat?
gloss: Second, third, fourth... which word comes before them all? — "una" (first): the ordinal of one is not built with ika- like the rest; the pun is that "nauuna" (comes first) contains it.

text: Kung “dalawampu” ang 20, anong bilang ang “tatlumpu’t lima”?
gloss: If "dalawampu" is 20, what number is "tatlumpu't lima"? — 35: tatlo (3) + -mpu (tens) and lima (5).

text: Ang “bukas” ay “ang susunod na araw”. Ano pa ang kahulugan nito kapag iba ang diin?
gloss: "Bukas" means "the next day". What else does it mean with a different stress? — "not closed": búkas is tomorrow, bukás is open.

text: Ano ang ibig sabihin kapag sinabing “balat-sibuyas” ang isang tao?
gloss: What does it mean to call someone "onion-skinned"? — easily hurt or offended: the idiom for an over-sensitive person.

text: Sa pagmamano, saan idinidikit ang likod ng kamay ng nakatatanda?
gloss: In "pagmamano", where do you press the back of the elder's hand? — to the forehead: the gesture of respect for elders.

text: Sa larawang sumasagisag sa bayanihan, ano ang sama-samang pinapasan ng magkakapitbahay?
gloss: In the iconic image of bayanihan, what do neighbours carry together? — a house: the community moving a nipa house on bamboo poles.

text: Anong hugis mayroon ang tradisyonal na parol na isinasabit tuwing Pasko?
gloss: What shape is the traditional Christmas parol lantern? — a star, recalling the Star of Bethlehem.

text: Sa mitolohiyang Norse, anong sandata ang hawak ng diyos ng kulog na si Thor?
gloss: In Norse mythology, what weapon does the thunder god Thor wield? — a hammer, Mjölnir.

text: Sa “Ibong Adarna”, bakit hinanap ng tatlong prinsipe ang mahiwagang ibon?
gloss: In "Ibong Adarna", why did the three princes seek the magic bird? — to cure their father, King Fernando: only its song could heal him.

text: Halos kasinlaki ng utak nito ang bawat mata ng maliit na hayop na ito na dinarayo sa Bohol. Ano ito?
gloss: Each eye of this small animal, a Bohol attraction, is about as big as its brain. What is it? — the Philippine tarsier.

text: Itlog ng anong ibon ang karaniwang ginagawang balut?
gloss: Whose egg is usually made into balut? — the duck's (itik): a fertilised duck egg boiled with the embryo inside.

text: Ano ang tawag sa malaking kahong puno ng pasalubong na ipinapadala ng OFW sa kanyang pamilya?
gloss: What is the big box of gifts an overseas worker ships home called? — the balikbayan box; bayong, tampipi and kaban are other containers.

text: Bakit hindi dapat isama ang aluminum foil sa loob ng microwave?
gloss: Why shouldn't aluminium foil go in a microwave? — it can spark and start a fire: the metal reflects the microwaves and arcs.

text: Sa sunscreen, ano ang sinusukat ng “SPF”?
gloss: On sunscreen, what does SPF measure? — protection against sunburn (Sun Protection Factor).

text: Mga ilang digri Celsius ang normal na temperatura ng katawan ng tao?
gloss: About how many degrees Celsius is normal human body temperature? — about 37 °C.

text: Ano ang hinihiling ng “RSVP” na nakasulat sa imbitasyon sa kasal?
gloss: What does "RSVP" on a wedding invitation ask? — to reply whether you will come (French "répondez s'il vous plaît").

text: Saang bahagi ng sobre karaniwang idinidikit ang selyo?
gloss: Where on an envelope does the stamp usually go? — top right.

text: Ano ang OTP na ipinapadala sa iyo sa text bago ituloy ang online na bayad?
options: Code na isang beses lang magagamit
gloss: What is the OTP texted to you before an online payment goes through? — a code usable only once (one-time PIN/password).

text: Sa Instagram at Facebook, anong uri ng post ang kusang nawawala pagkalipas ng 24 oras?
gloss: On Instagram and Facebook, which kind of post disappears by itself after 24 hours? — a Story.

text: Sa mundo ni Harry Potter, anong laro ang nilalaro habang nakasakay sa walis?
gloss: In Harry Potter's world, which game is played on broomsticks? — Quidditch.

text: Pagkatapos mong kumanta sa videoke, ano ang karaniwang ipinapakita ng makina sa screen?
gloss: After you sing on a videoke machine, what does it usually show on screen? — a score, the moment every Filipino party waits for.

text: Sa volleyball, hanggang ilang palo ang puwede sa isang koponan bago itawid ang bola sa net?
gloss: In volleyball, up to how many hits may a team make before sending the ball over? — three.

text: Sa bowling, ano ang tawag kapag napatumba mo ang lahat ng sampung pin sa unang tira?
gloss: In bowling, what is knocking down all ten pins with the first ball called? — a strike (a spare takes two balls).

text: Aling bansa ang pinakamalapit na kapitbahay ng Pilipinas sa dakong hilaga ng Batanes?
gloss: Which country is the Philippines' nearest neighbour north of Batanes? — Taiwan, across the Bashi Channel.

text: Anong kape ang espresso na hinaluan ng maraming steamed milk at may manipis na foam sa ibabaw?
gloss: Which coffee is espresso with plenty of steamed milk and a thin layer of foam? — A latte; an Americano is espresso with hot water, ristretto and doppio are espresso shots.

text: Ano ang tawag sa guhit ng mukha ng tao na sadyang pinalalaki ang ilong, tainga o ngiti para magpatawa?
gloss: What is a drawing of a face that exaggerates the nose, ears or smile for fun called? — a caricature.

text: Alin ang tamang ipupuno: “Tumakbo siya ___ mabilis.”
gloss: Which fills the blank: "He ran ___ fast"? — "nang": it links a verb to the adverb describing it; "ng" marks a noun.

text: Kapag sinabing “nagbibilang ng poste” ang isang tao, ano ang kalagayan niya?
gloss: If someone is "counting lamp posts", what is their situation? — jobless: the idiom for having nothing to do but walk the streets.

text: Sinong mang-aawit ang tinaguriang “Asia’s Songbird”?
gloss: Which singer is called "Asia's Songbird"? — Regine Velasquez.

text: Aling katutubong sining ng pakikipaglaban gamit ang yantok ang itinakdang pambansang isport noong 2009?
gloss: Which native martial art fought with rattan sticks was made the national sport in 2009? — arnis (Republic Act 9850); sipa was long called the national sport before it.

text: Nagpakadalubhasa si Rizal sa isang sangay ng medisina para gamutin ang kanyang ina. Saang bahagi ng katawan?
gloss: Rizal specialised in a branch of medicine to treat his mother. Which part of the body? — the eyes: he studied ophthalmology and operated on her cataract.

text: Bakit pumapresko ang pakiramdam sa harap ng electric fan kahit hindi lumalamig ang kuwarto?
options: Naglalabas ito ng malamig na hangin
Pinabibilis nito ang pagsingaw ng pawis
Hinihigop nito ang init ng kuwarto
gloss: Why does a fan feel cooling though the room doesn't get colder? — it speeds up the evaporation of sweat, which takes heat from the skin.

text: Bakit umaalsa ang masa ng tinapay kapag nilagyan ng yeast?
gloss: Why does bread dough rise with yeast? — the yeast gives off carbon dioxide, whose bubbles puff up the dough.

text: Sa email, aling field ang ginagamit para padalhan ng kopya ang isang tao nang hindi ito nakikita ng ibang tumanggap?
gloss: In email, which field sends someone a copy without the other recipients seeing it? — BCC (blind carbon copy).

text: Sa tennis, anong salita ang ginagamit sa halip na “zero” sa iskor?
gloss: In tennis, which word replaces "zero" in the score? — love.

text: Aling sinaunang kabihasnan ang nagtayo ng Machu Picchu sa kabundukan ng Peru?
gloss: Which ancient civilisation built Machu Picchu in the Peruvian mountains? — the Inca.

text: Sa “The Matrix”, anong kulay ng tableta ang pinili ni Neo para malaman ang katotohanan?
gloss: In "The Matrix", which colour pill does Neo take to learn the truth? — red; the blue one would have sent him back to his illusion.

text: Hindi dumaraan sa Pilipinas ang ekwador. Aling kalapit na bansa ang tinatawid nito?
gloss: The equator does not cross the Philippines. Which neighbouring country does it cross? — Indonesia (Sumatra, Borneo, Sulawesi); Malaysia, Brunei and Papua New Guinea lie just off it.

text: Ilang tig-bebente ang bubuo sa isang libong piso?
gloss: How many twenty-peso pieces make a thousand pesos? — 50: 1,000 ÷ 20.

text: Bakit kulay-rosas ang balahibo ng flamingo?
options: Dahil sa kinakain nitong hipon at lumot
Dahil sa tindi ng sikat ng araw
Dahil sa dugong malapit sa balat
Dahil sa putik na pinaliliguan nito
gloss: Why are flamingo feathers pink? — pigments (carotenoids) in the shrimp and algae they eat.

text: Sa ilang magkakaibang dibisyon ng timbang naging kampeon sa mundo si Manny Pacquiao?
gloss: In how many weight divisions did Manny Pacquiao win world titles? — 8, the only boxer ever to do so.

text: Ang Simbahan ng Paoay sa Ilocos Norte, na may dambuhalang mga buttress sa gilid, ay halimbawa ng anong istilo?
gloss: Paoay Church in Ilocos Norte, with its huge side buttresses, is an example of which style? — Earthquake Baroque, built low and buttressed against quakes (a UNESCO World Heritage site).

text: Bakit hinahaluan ng asin ang yelo sa garapinyera kapag gumagawa ng sorbetes?
options: Para lumamig pa ito nang lampas sa 0 °C
Para hindi agad matunaw ang yelo
gloss: Why is salt mixed with the ice in a sorbetes churn? — salt lowers the melting point, so the brine gets colder than 0 °C and freezes the cream; the ice actually melts faster.

text: Ano ang tawag sa hanay ng maliliit na gong na tinutugtog ng mga Maranao at Maguindanao?
gloss: What is the row of small gongs played by the Maranao and Maguindanao called? — kulintang; the kudyapi is a lute, gangsa are Cordillera flat gongs, the agung a single large gong.

text: Ang “kindergarten” ay literal na “hardin ng mga bata”. Sa anong wika ito hiniram?
gloss: "Kindergarten" literally means "garden of children". From which language is it borrowed? — German: Kinder (children) + Garten (garden), coined by Friedrich Fröbel.

text: Saang lungsod sa Mindanao nahukay ang mga sinaunang bangkang balangay na mahigit isang libong taon na ang tanda?
gloss: In which Mindanao city were the ancient balangay boats, over a thousand years old, excavated? — Butuan (Agusan del Norte), from 1976 on.

text: Ang “Na” ng sodium ay mula sa Latin na “natrium”. Aling elemento ang “K”, mula sa “kalium”?
gloss: Sodium's "Na" comes from Latin "natrium". Which element is "K", from "kalium"? — potassium; calcium is Ca, krypton Kr, cobalt Co.

text: Anong artepakto, na may petsang 900 AD, ang pinakamatandang kilalang nakasulat na dokumento sa Pilipinas?
gloss: Which artefact, dated 900 AD, is the oldest known written document in the Philippines? — the Laguna Copperplate Inscription (Saka year 822); the ivory seal and the pot are later, the Manunggul Jar bears no writing.
